description: Golden dataset for the routing eval harness (v2 wave 1.5 #19). Each case: a GitHub issue title/body plus a synthetic repo-context signal (language histogram + manifest excerpts, shaped like what get_repo_context produces), and the expected routing outcome. 'expected' lists the exact bespoke domain set; 'expect_fallback: true' instead means every predicted domain must fall OUTSIDE the bespoke registry. Boundary cases are included deliberately — the harness exists to measure them, not to look good.

cases.title: Save button on settings page doesn't respond to clicks
cases.body: On /settings, clicking Save does nothing — no spinner, no request in the network tab. Started after the last release. Repro in Chrome and Safari.

cases.title: Email field accepts invalid addresses
cases.body: The signup form submits 'a@b' as a valid email. Should validate format client-side before submit and show an inline error.

cases.title: Add CSV export endpoint for transactions
cases.body: Need GET /api/transactions/export returning CSV of all transactions for the authed user. Should stream for large datasets and require the same auth as /api/transactions.

cases.title: Login endpoint has no rate limiting
cases.body: POST /auth/login can be hammered indefinitely. Add per-IP rate limiting (e.g. 5 req/min) returning 429 with Retry-After.

cases.title: Deploys failing with OOM on the worker service
cases.body: Since last week the worker container gets OOMKilled during rollout. Bump memory limits and add a liveness probe so the rollout doesn't wedge halfway.

cases.title: CI pipeline intermittently fails on cache restore
cases.body: The build job fails ~30% of the time restoring the pnpm cache with a tar corruption error. Pin the cache key to the lockfile hash and add a fallback restore key.

cases.title: App crashes when rotating to landscape on profile screen
cases.body: On Android, rotating the device on the profile screen loses form state then crashes with a NPE. Repro: open profile, type in bio, rotate.

manifests.pubspec.yaml:
name: app
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter

cases.title: Messages sent offline never sync when back online
cases.body: In airplane mode the app lets you 'send' messages, but they vanish instead of queuing and syncing when connectivity returns.

cases.title: Churn model accuracy dropped 12% after pipeline refactor
cases.body: After merging the feature-pipeline refactor, offline eval AUC fell from 0.81 to 0.69. Suspect train/serve skew in the new feature code. Need the eval re-run and the skew found.

cases.title: Re-running the nightly ETL duplicates rows in the features table
cases.body: The nightly feature pipeline isn't idempotent — a retry after a partial failure double-writes rows. Make re-runs safe (upsert or delete-then-write per partition).

cases.title: CLI exits 0 when the input file doesn't exist
cases.body: `tool convert missing.json` prints an error but exits 0, so our CI step silently passes. Should exit non-zero and print the error to stderr.

cases.title: Flag doesn't override config file value
cases.body: `--format json` is ignored when ~/.toolrc sets format=yaml. Expected precedence: flag > env var > config file. Document the order in --help too.

cases.title: Device resets mid-OTA when flash write takes too long
cases.body: During OTA update the watchdog fires while the new image is being written to flash, bricking the device until power cycle. Feed the watchdog during long flash ops or use a hardware timeout window.

cases.title: Sensor read hangs forever when I2C bus is stuck
cases.body: If the sensor holds SDA low, i2c_read blocks forever and the main loop stalls. Add a bus-timeout and recovery (clock out 9 pulses) instead of blocking.

cases.title: FPS tanks from 60 to 20 when explosion particles spawn
cases.body: Every explosion allocates new particle objects per frame. Profile shows GC spikes. Pool the particles and pre-warm the pool at scene load.

cases.title: Jump input feels delayed on gamepad
cases.body: Jump registers ~100ms late on gamepad but instantly on keyboard. Input is polled in the render loop instead of the fixed update; move it and buffer presses.

cases.title: Stored XSS via profile bio field
cases.body: Setting my bio to `` executes JS for anyone viewing my profile. Sanitize/escape user content before rendering.

cases.title: Webhook URL field allows hitting internal metadata endpoint
cases.body: Registering a webhook with URL http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data makes our server fetch it. Validate outbound webhook URLs against internal ranges.

cases.title: Orders list endpoint takes 8s for accounts with many orders
cases.body: GET /orders does a full table scan — seq scan on 2M rows in pg_stat. Add an index on (account_id, created_at) and paginate the endpoint.

cases.title: Last migration locked the users table for 4 minutes in prod
cases.body: Adding a column with a default rewrote the whole table. Rewrite the migration to add the column nullable, backfill in batches, then set the default.

cases.title: Add /export API endpoint and an Export button in the UI
cases.body: Backend: GET /api/reports/export returning CSV. Frontend: an Export button on the reports page that downloads it, with loading and error states.

cases.title: Route read queries to the new read replica and migrate the schema
cases.body: Infra: stand up the read replica and wire failover into the deploy. Data: migrate orders to include region_id (batched backfill) so reads can be routed by region.

cases.title: Nightly batch job abends with S0C7 in the settlement step
cases.body: The settlement COBOL step abends on packed-decimal data from the upstream feed. Need the copybook validated and a graceful abend handler.

cases.title: Staking contract allows re-entrant reward claims
cases.body: claimRewards() updates state after the external call — a malicious contract can drain rewards via re-entrancy. Apply checks-effects-interactions.

cases.title: Monte Carlo sim produces different results across runs
cases.body: The atmospheric sim isn't seeding its RNG from the namelist parameter, so results differ run to run. Thread the seed through init_rng.

cases.title: Orders pagination skips rows — page 1 starts at the wrong record
cases.body: list_orders is 1-indexed by page, but page 1 currently skips the first per_page rows (we seeded ids 1..9, page 1 with per_page 3 should return ids 1,2,3 but returns 4,5,6). Every page is shifted by one page worth of rows.

cases.title: Customer totals report merges different customers and shows cents as dollars
cases.body: Two bugs in the customer-totals report: (1) customers who happen to share a name get merged into one row — totals must be grouped by customer id, not name; (2) amounts render 100x too large — total_cents is shown as if it were already dollars.

cases.title: File download endpoint allows path traversal outside the upload dir
cases.body: read_user_file('../../etc/passwd') happily reads files outside the upload directory. Names must be confined to the upload dir — reject absolute paths and any name that escapes it (e.g. containing '..') with a ValueError.

cases.title: Search endpoint allows SQL injection via the q parameter
cases.body: GET /search?q=' OR 1=1 -- dumps the whole users table. The view interpolates q straight into raw SQL. Switch to parameterized queries and add a regression test.

cases.title: Orders API gets slower the bigger the page — one query per row
cases.body: GET /orders?per_page=50 issues 51 queries (pg_stat shows an N+1 on order_items). Eager-load the related rows and keep the endpoint paginated.

cases.title: Worker pods OOMKilled since the in-memory cache shipped
cases.body: Pods started getting OOMKilled right after the new response cache merged. The cache dict grows unboundedly — bound it with an LRU and a max size. (Please don't just bump the memory limit again.)

cases.title: Prediction API 500s whenever the payload has missing features
cases.body: POST /predict throws on any request with NaNs. Training used an imputer, but the serving path never applies it — apply the same preprocessing pipeline at serve time so train and serve can't skew.

cases.title: Exported CSV executes formulas when opened in Excel
cases.body: If a user's display name is '=HYPERLINK(...)' the exported CSV runs it on open. Prefix dangerous leading characters (=, +, -, @) with a quote when serializing export rows.

cases.title: Long-running report requests die at exactly 15s since the mesh rollout
cases.body: Since the Istio sidecar rollout, /reports/generate calls that take >15s return 503. The sidecar's default route timeout is truncating them — raise the route timeout for that service.
